sermon.title: How People with Faith in God Responded to a Miracle — June 6, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer walks through John 9 and how people who believed in God responded when Jesus opened the eyes of a man born blind. Nobody had faith for the healing; the man believed after Jesus spoke to him, testified about what he experienced, and was cast out. He says faith is overemphasized, tells how he was saved at an altar in Norwalk, California, and calls the church to invite Jesus through praise, assembling, prayer and the word.

faqs.question: Did faith die on the cross?
faqs.answer: No. Faith didn’t die on that cross, grace didn’t die on that cross; Jesus Christ died on that cross.

faqs.question: Did anyone at the pool have faith?

In these lay a great multitude of sick people, blind, lame, paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water. For an angel went down at a certain time into the pool and stirred up the water; then whoever stepped in first, after the stirring of the water, was made well of whatever disease he had. Now a certain man was there who had an infirmity thirty-eight years. When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he already had been in that condition a long time, He said to him, “Do you want to be made well?” The sick man answered Him, “Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up; but while I am coming, another steps down before me.” Jesus said to him, “Rise, take up your bed and walk.” And immediately the man was made well, took up his bed, and walked.
